self.assertEqual(exc.errors, [(3, '    continuation')])

    def _make_mlc_error(self, input_string):
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser(allow_no_value=True)
        with self.assertRaises(configparser.ParsingError) as ctx:
            parser.read_string(input_string, source='test.cfg')
        return ctx.exception

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror_copy(self):
        import copy
        for input_string in ('[section]\noption\n    continuation',
                              '[section]\noption\n    continuation\n'):
            exc = self._make_mlc_error(input_string)
            exc2 = copy.copy(exc)
            self.assertIs(type(exc2), configparser.MultilineContinuationError)
            self.assertEqual(exc2.args, ('test.cfg', 3, '    continuation'))
            self.assertEqual(exc2.source, 'test.cfg')
            self.assertEqual(exc2.lineno, 3)
            self.assertEqual(exc2.line, '    continuation')
            self.assertEqual(exc2.errors, [(3, '    continuation')])
            self.assertEqual(exc2.message, exc.message)
            self.assertEqual(repr(exc2), repr(exc))

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror_deepcopy(self):
        import copy
        for input_string in ('[section]\noption\n    continuation',
                              '[section]\noption\n    continuation\n'):
            exc = self._make_mlc_error(input_string)
            exc2 = copy.deepcopy(exc)
            self.assertIs(type(exc2), configparser.MultilineContinuationError)
            self.assertEqual(exc2.args, ('test.cfg', 3, '    continuation'))
            self.assertEqual(exc2.source, 'test.cfg')
            self.assertEqual(exc2.lineno, 3)
            self.assertEqual(exc2.line, '    continuation')
            self.assertEqual(exc2.errors, [(3, '    continuation')])
            self.assertEqual(exc2.message, exc.message)
            self.assertEqual(repr(exc2), repr(exc))

    def test_multilinecontinuationerror_pickle(self):
        import pickle
        for input_string in ('[section]\noption\n    continuation',
                              '[section]\noption\n    continuation\n'):
            exc = self._make_mlc_error(input_string)
            for proto in range(pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL + 1):
                pickled = pickle.dumps(exc, proto)
